description: Complete the TUI keyboard shortcuts implementation including quadrant switching (Ctrl+1/2/3/4), focused view mode, and discoverable help text for keyboard navigation.
workflow_rationale: This is a FEATURE workflow because we're implementing new functionality (quadrant switching keyboard navigation) that adds to the existing TUI system. The changes are focused on the web frontend and enhance existing user interaction patterns.

phases.name: Add Quadrant State Management
phases.description: Add activeQuadrant state to mission-control-store.ts to track which quadrant currently has focus, and a view mode state for grid vs focused view.

subtasks.description: Add activeQuadrant and viewMode state to mission-control store

verification.command: cd web && bun run build 2>&1 | head -20
verification.expected: Build successful or no TypeScript errors

phases.name: Implement Keyboard Handlers
phases.description: Implement the Ctrl+1/2/3/4 keyboard handlers in use-keyboard-shortcuts.ts to switch between quadrants.

verification.expected: Keyboard handler code for case "1" found

subtasks.description: Add onQuadrantSwitch callback to useKeyboardShortcuts hook

verification.instructions: Review that onQuadrantSwitch callback is added to UseKeyboardShortcutsOptions interface and implemented in the hook

subtasks.notes:
Successfully added onQuadrantSwitch callback to useKeyboardShortcuts hook:
- Added onQuadrantSwitch?: (quadrant: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4) => void to UseKeyboardShortcutsOptions interface
- Extracted onQuadrantSwitch from options
- Call callback when switching quadrants (after setActiveQuadrant and setViewMode)
- Added to useCallback dependency array
- TypeScript verification passed with no errors

phases.name: Implement Focused View Mode
phases.description: Implement the focused view mode in mission-control.tsx that shows one quadrant at full screen when active, with smooth transitions.

subtasks.description: Add focused view rendering logic to mission-control.tsx

verification.instructions: Review that conditional rendering exists for grid vs focused view based on activeQuadrant state

subtasks.notes:
Successfully added focused view rendering logic:
- Imported activeQuadrant and viewMode state from mission-control-store
- Added renderFocusedQuadrant helper function that returns the appropriate quadrant component based on activeQuadrant (1-4)
- Implemented conditional rendering in main content area: focused view when viewMode === 'focused' && activeQuadrant is set, otherwise grid view
- Used Framer Motion AnimatePresence for smooth transitions between views
- TypeScript compilation passes with no errors

subtasks.description: Wire up keyboard shortcuts to trigger quadrant changes

verification.instructions: Verify that onQuadrantSwitch callback is passed to useKeyboardShortcuts and triggers state changes

subtasks.notes:
Successfully wired up keyboard shortcuts to trigger quadrant changes:
- Added setActiveQuadrant and setViewMode selectors from mission-control-store
- Added onQuadrantSwitch callback to useKeyboardShortcuts hook options
- Callback properly updates store state: setActiveQuadrant(quadrant) and setViewMode('focused')
- When Ctrl+1/2/3/4 is pressed, the hook calls the callback which triggers state changes
- TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
- No console.log statements present

phases.name: Integration and Testing
phases.description: End-to-end verification of keyboard navigation including quadrant switching, focused view mode, and help text display.

subtasks.description: Browser verification of quadrant switching functionality

checks: Pressing Ctrl+1 switches to The Eye (top-left) quadrant focused view
Pressing Ctrl+2 switches to The Coil (top-right) quadrant focused view
Pressing Ctrl+3 switches to The Council (bottom-left) quadrant focused view
Pressing Ctrl+4 switches to The Strike (bottom-right) quadrant focused view
Pressing Ctrl+0 or Escape returns to grid view showing all 4 quadrants
Settings page displays all keyboard shortcuts including quadrant switching
No console errors during keyboard navigation
Smooth transitions between grid and focused views

parallel_groups.reason: Phase 4 can run in parallel with Phase 3 once keyboard handlers are implemented in Phase 2

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential execution recommended due to tight dependencies

acceptance_criteria: All keyboard shortcuts defined in use-keyboard-shortcuts.ts are implemented
Quadrant switching works correctly to navigate between TUI sections
Focused view mode displays selected quadrant at full screen
No TODO comments remain in keyboard shortcut handling
Keyboard navigation is discoverable with help text in settings
